name: Week 5 — Guardrail and Output Validation Tests
description: Test cases for input guardrails, evidence sufficiency, output validation, and without-vs-with guardrail demonstration.

tests.input: What are the main parts of a loan?
tests.description: In-scope loan question — should be allowed and answered

tests.input: What is the current price of Bitcoin?
tests.description: Explicit out-of-scope question — must be rejected by input guardrail

tests.input: What is the exact late-payment penalty percentage at HDFC Bank?
tests.description: HDFC-specific rate not in KB and 'late-payment penalty' without 'loan' keyword — correctly blocked by scope guardrail
Empty input — must be rejected by input guardrail
Whitespace-only input — must be rejected by input guardrail

tests.input: What is a loan? Tell me more about loans and interest rates and repayment options and eligibility requirements and documentation and credit scores and debt-to-income ratios and processing fees and insurance and late payment penalties and foreclosure options and prepayment charges and guarantor requirements and collateral valuation and loan-to-value ratios and fixed versus variable rates and amortization schedules and balloon payments and refinancing options and debt consolidation and credit counselling and bankruptcy implications. What is a loan? Tell me more about loans and interest rates and repayment options and eligibility requirements and documentation and credit scores and debt-to-income ratios and processing fees and insurance and late payment penalties and foreclosure options and prepayment charges and guarantor requirements and collateral valuation and loan-to-value ratios and fixed versus variable rates and amortization schedules. This question is intentionally very long to test the length guardrail and ensure the system rejects inputs that exceed the maximum allowed character limit.
tests.description: Input exceeding MAX_INPUT_LENGTH — must be rejected by length guardrail

tests.input: What does an EMI consist of?
tests.description: Well-supported question — EMI info is in loan_repayment.txt
Sports question — must be rejected by input guardrail
Weather question — must be rejected by input guardrail

tests.input: What happens if a borrower defaults on a secured loan?
tests.description: Supported loan question — should produce a grounded answer

tests.input: Write a Python program to sort a list.
tests.description: Programming task unrelated to loans — must be rejected

tests.input: What is the capital city of Australia?
tests.description: General knowledge geography question — must be rejected

tests.input: What documents are required for a loan application?
tests.description: Common loan question with clear KB support

tests.input: What is the difference between simple and compound interest?
tests.description: Comparison question — well covered in loan_interest.txt

tests.input: What is the current repo rate set by the Reserve Bank of India?
tests.description: RBI repo rate — real-time financial data, should be blocked by scope guardrail
